data.comment:
# Comfy Flux Video Edit

Edit and transform images with FLUX using simple text prompts. Change characters, objects, backgrounds, styles, or entire scenes while preserving the key details and overall consistency of the original image. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_flux_video_edit.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.prompt: Replace the guitarist with a photorealistic gorilla wearing a casual brown jacket and jeans, sitting in exactly the same pose and seriously playing the acoustic guitar. Keep the subway station, pedestrians, bench, lighting and composition unchanged. Completely realistic photography, deadpan humor.
